Next I will check the factual-fit constraint. I will run a factual pass with both models on the same 100 drug-heavy tuning stays, a worst case because they hold the most drug bundles. My hypothesis is that the value NLL per reading rises by well under 0.005 nats, likely under 0.001, since the dose level carries little information beyond the readings. A rise near or above 0.005 would mean the model leans on dose magnitude for factual prediction, and I would need a gentler edit.
